text: Exposed a narrow public API centered on measurement_frame(), explicit edge_frame(), variation_query(), and measurement_form(left, between, by, over, right). Added capability-gated effect/covariance/canonical/alignment/connectivity views, explicit Gaussian model declaration, coherent/configuration component summaries, and exact/projected evidence reconstruction. Updated DESCRIPTION and README and added a fully executable installed-package vignette covering scalar sign, multivariate spectra, rank-one rejection, crossed decompositions, cross-domain forms, capability tables, migration terminology, and Parseval reconstruction. Installed current source and rendered both vignettes successfully; offline seven-page visual review found no clipping or layout defects. Full suite passes in two groups: 752 plus 883 expectations.
